dimensions.label: State/action/observer contract
dimensions.displayLabel: 状态 / 动作 / 观测契约
evidence: Executable world/action schemas, state digests, unique branches and transactional rollback.
dimensions.nextAction: Move the runtime into a worker-backed append-only action log.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Fresh worker restoration reproduces state digest, parent chain and ordered actions across 1/5/20 horizons.

dimensions.label: Data and provenance
dimensions.nextAction: Add hashed, licensed public atomistic benchmark manifests.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Every dataset entry has digest, license, units, electronic-structure settings and split lineage.

dimensions.label: Atomistic physics
dimensions.summary: LJ 求解器 + 守恒回归
evidence: Force finite-difference, cutoff continuity, exact pair momentum and 10k-step NVE drift tests.
dimensions.nextAction: Reproduce two pinned open foundation potentials on one locked held-out benchmark.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Energy, force, stress, stability, OOD and cost metrics are reproduced with checkpoint and runner digests.

dimensions.label: Mesoscale
dimensions.nextAction: Implement the pinned NIST PFHub Benchmark 3 coupled phase/heat case.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Free energy, solid fraction, tip position and zero contour meet preregistered PFHub tolerances.

dimensions.label: Continuum fields
evidence: Periodic 2D heat solver, automatic CFL subcycling, maximum principle and analytic Fourier decay.
dimensions.nextAction: Replace fixed per-cell heat capacity with an area-scaled heat-capacity density, then add grid convergence and a community coupled-field benchmark.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Domain heat capacity is grid-invariant, Fourier order is at least 1.8, and PFHub case outputs match the locked reference envelope.

dimensions.label: Reactor and process
dimensions.summary: 仅 A→B 标签，非反应器
dimensions.nextAction: Reproduce a pinned Cantera 3.2 CSTR before adding any process recommendation.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Species, temperature and energy trajectories match the locked Cantera reference and close balances below 0.1%.

dimensions.label: Cross-scale coupling
dimensions.summary: MD ↔ 热场 ↔ 反应账本
evidence: Cell-COM thermal exchange, frozen Arrhenius hazards, symmetric split and explicit energy closures.
dimensions.nextAction: Add analytic two-reservoir exchange and forced single-reaction closure gates before replacing hand-set coefficients with a calibrated narrow material bridge.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Analytic exchange and forced reaction ledgers close independently, interface closure remains below 1e-10 Eref, and held-out transport quantities remain inside calibrated intervals.

dimensions.label: Multi-turn world behavior
evidence: Content-disambiguated state/action IDs, complete integrity digests, idempotent branch tokens, full-state serialization and deterministic counter RNG.
dimensions.nextAction: Persist append-only histories and quantify rollout error at 1/5/20 horizons.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: No state collision, ordering ambiguity, NaN or unexplained error growth across locked action sequences.

dimensions.label: Uncertainty and OOD
dimensions.summary: 动作域拒绝，尚无校准 UQ
evidence: Machine-readable rejection for unsupported temperatures, pulse sizes, horizons and reaction hazards.
dimensions.nextAction: Bound density, grid size, diffusivity, heat capacity, kinetics and subcycling cost before separating and calibrating numerical, parameter and model-form uncertainty.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Every supported parameter has a machine-readable envelope and cost limit; locked 90% intervals cover 85–95% in-domain and abstain on preregistered OOD cases.

dimensions.label: Reproducibility and cost
dimensions.summary: 固定随机流 + CI 门禁
evidence: Counter-based reaction randomness, deterministic replay, and a configured GitHub CI gate whose outcomes are recorded per report.
dimensions.nextAction: Record p50/p95 runtime, platform fingerprint and two-run artifact equality.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Two clean runners reproduce the manifest and stay inside the preregistered latency envelope.

dimensions.label: Visualization truthfulness
dimensions.summary: 粒子 / 热场 / 账本同帧
evidence: Canvas heat field, particle species, state ID, timestamp and ledger are derived from one observation snapshot.
dimensions.nextAction: Add selectable state probes and downloadable immutable observations.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: A sampled pixel/cell/particle probe resolves to the displayed state digest and numeric source.

dimensions.label: Safety, license and governance
dimensions.displayLabel: 安全 / 许可 / 治理
evidence: Visible toy-model boundary, claim lint, a configured dependency-audit gate and no control-output endpoint.
dimensions.nextAction: Add model/data license manifests and an SBOM artifact.
dimensions.acceptanceTest: Dependency, model and dataset license gates pass and no direct control endpoint exists.

comparators.name: MACE-MPA-0
comparators.reason: Second open reproduction control; exact checkpoint and runner are not yet pinned locally.

comparators.name: NIST PFHub Benchmark 3
comparators.reason: Community reference for the next mesoscale coupling stage; not implemented in R1.

comparators.name: Cantera 3.2 CSTR
comparators.reason: Pinned reactor reference planned for R2; R1 A/B labels are not a reactor model.

comparators.name: IDAES 2.12
comparators.scope: process systems, unit models and constrained optimization
comparators.reason: Process anchor for later stages; no coupled flowsheet exists in R1.
